name: ostomy-application
description: Dual-platform (mobile + web) patient-facing app for ostomy care tracking.

scripts.//build:deps: Every workspace whose consumers typecheck against its BUILT output must be listed here, in dependency order. `packages/ui` was missing and CI caught it: a clean checkout has no `packages/ui/dist`, so `apps/web`'s typecheck could not resolve `@ostomy/ui` — while every local run passed, because a stale dist from an earlier build was still on disk. Adding a package here is not optional bookkeeping; it is the difference between `pnpm verify` meaning something on a fresh clone and meaning nothing.
scripts.build:deps: pnpm --filter @ostomy/core build && pnpm --filter @ostomy/seed build && pnpm --filter @ostomy/ui build
scripts.verify:build-artifact: pnpm --filter @ostomy/api build && node -e "require('./apps/api/dist/prisma/prisma.service.js'); console.log('built CJS artifact loads: apps/api/dist/prisma/prisma.service.js')"
scripts.verify:core-require: pnpm --filter @ostomy/core build && node apps/api/scripts/require-core-smoke.cjs && echo "apps/api (CommonJS) required @ostomy/core (ESM) built output successfully - ADR-0010 proof"
scripts.verify: pnpm run check:env && pnpm run format && pnpm run build:deps && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run verify:build-artifact && pnpm run verify:core-require && pnpm run verify:api-client

pnpm.//overrides: multer: three high-severity DoS advisories (GHSA-wc9g-mqfw-jrwm, GHSA-qfvm-cv95-jqjf, GHSA-g5hg-p3ph-g8qg) affect multer <2.3.0, and 2.2.0 is what `@nestjs/platform-express` pins. There is nothing to bump to: @nestjs/platform-express@latest IS 12.0.1, the version this repo already uses, and it still depends on multer@2.2.0 — so the override is the only route to a patched version until NestJS releases one. Remove it then, and not before. Safe here specifically because `apps/api` performs no multipart handling at all: there is no FileInterceptor, no @UploadedFile, and no multer import anywhere in src/, and none is planned — SRS_v2 section 4 routes photo uploads through S3 presigned URLs, so bytes never transit the API. multer is dead weight in the dependency graph that `@nestjs/platform-express` drags in regardless. This is scoped to a version range rather than pinned exactly so a 2.3.x patch is picked up without another commit.
pnpm.//overrides-react: One React for the whole repo, because `.npmrc` sets node-linker=hoisted. Hoisting puts a single react-dom at the root while a workspace whose range excludes the hoisted react keeps its own nested copy - so components render against one React instance and react-dom's dispatcher is bound to another. That does not error: it renders NOTHING, and packages/ui's suite failed 21 tests with an empty <div /> and no clue why. 19.2.3 is Expo SDK 57's pin and the version React Native 0.86 is tested against, so the native side chooses it and everything else follows. Raise this only in step with an Expo upgrade.
pnpm.//overrides-brace-expansion: brace-expansion: two high-severity DoS advisories (GHSA-6j4f-fj2g-mc7p and its follow-up) affect <1.1.20 on the v1 line and >=4.0.0 <5.0.11 on the v5 line. Both lines are present because the graph reaches brace-expansion through minimatch twice: eslint-config-prettier>eslint>minimatch pulls v1, expo>@expo/cli>glob>minimatch pulls v5. Neither is a dependency this repo chose or imports — both are build tooling — and the vulnerable path is parsing an attacker-supplied glob, which nothing here does: every glob in this repo is a literal in a config file. Two entries rather than one because no single range spans both majors and minimatch v3 requires brace-expansion ^1.1.7. Scoped to ranges rather than pinned, so a later patch is picked up without another commit. Remove each when its upstream ships a patched minimatch, and not before.
